content: पुष्पम् [पुष्प् विकाशे-अच्] .²1 A flower, blossom; पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोय यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति <ls>Bg. 9. 26</ls>. .²2 The menstrual discharge; as in पुष्पवती <ab>q. v.</ab> .²3 A topaz (पुष्पराग); <ls>Rām. 2. 94. 6</ls>. .²4 A disease of the eyes (albugo). .²5 The car or vehicle of Kubera; see पुष्पक. .²6 Gallantry, politeness (in love language). .²7 Expanding, blooming, blossoming (said to be {%m.%} in this sense).
